mercimek.name: Rēmana Pēhi
mercimek.description: Rēmana pēhi hanga-a-ringa i te momo tuku iho, oti i te tīhi pata.

tas-kebabi.name: Rākau Pihikete Pākehā Tūki
tas-kebabi.description: Pihikete, huawhenua wā, me te rēmana motuhake a tō mātou wharekai i kīnaki mā te tunu ātaahua.

kuzu-tandir.name: Hipi Inu-Tunu Āta
kuzu-tandir.description: Te tandoori hipi tohu o tō mātou wharekai, kua tunua āta i te wera iti.

firin-sutlac.name: Hākari Rīwai Tunu
firin-sutlac.description: Rīwai tunu i te āhua tuku iho, i whakatapua ki te miraka pāmamao o ia rā.

kuru-fasulye.name: Rihi Pī White me Pēhi
kuru-fasulye.description: Ngā pī İspir, pēhi tapahia, me te pāme pāmu tomato o te wharekai.

izgara-kofte.name: Poaka Kīhini Paraoa
izgara-kofte.description: Ngā poi mīti pēhi ā-tuhi me pepa parai me tomato.

ayran.name: Ayran Whakarau
ayran.description: Miraka tīhi tuku iho o te tikanga tawhito me te nui o te pahū, hangaia me te miraka tii i ia rā.

ezogelin-corbasi.name: Rēmara Ezogelin
ezogelin-corbasi.description: He rēmara wharekai tuku iho e hui ana ngā pīnati whero, bulgur, me te raihi me te mīti.

tarhana-corbasi.name: Rēmara Tarhana
tarhana-corbasi.description: Tarhana hanga-a-roto, he tohu o Anatolia ka tunua a ngenge me te tomato me te mīti maroke.

yayla-corbasi.name: Rewena me te Tunu Parāoa Rīhi
yayla-corbasi.description: He kuwha hou, kirīmi rānei ā-wai me te rewena, rīhi, me te māmīti maroke.

iskembe-corbasi.name: Reweti Rīhi
iskembe-corbasi.description: He reweti kau tūturu ka whakaritea me tōna tauhi me te waina hekere.

dugun-corbasi.name: Reweti Tūāmai
dugun-corbasi.description: He reweti tuku iho mō te tūāmai ka hangaia mā te mīti hipi kōhua me te momona rēmana.

tavuk-suyu-corbasi.name: Reweti Hiku Hēki
tavuk-suyu-corbasi.description: He reweti whakaora ka whakaritea me ngā nūipi whakarahi i tunua i roto i te korokoro huhu me te mīti hēki ngarohanga.

domates-corbasi.name: Reweti Tāmato
domates-corbasi.description: He reka nui te rūrū i tunua me ngā tīmata mātua, pata, me te basil, ā, ka oti ki te tīhi.

sebze-corbasi.name: Rēmana Huawhenua
sebze-corbasi.description: He rēmana māmā o te wharekai i tunua me ngā huawhenua wā, hinu oriwa, me ngā rākau rāwhiti hou.

beyran-corbasi.name: Rēmana Hipi Rerehua
beyran-corbasi.description: He rēmana ā-rohe i tunua ki te wera teitei me te hipi, rīwai, tōmato, me te pepa wera.

kelle-paca-corbasi.name: Rēmana Upoko me ngā Waewae Hipi
kelle-paca-corbasi.description: He rēmana kōrero tohunga i hangaia me ngā wāewae hipi me te mīti upoko i whakamātao mō ētahi hāora roa.

sehriye-corbasi.name: Rēmana Whirikoka
sehriye-corbasi.description: Ka tunua te hēki o ia rā me te kohua heihei, me te tōmato, vermicelli, me te perehi.

tavuk-sis.name: Kākano Heihei
tavuk-sis.description: Ngā wāhanga heihei i marinatehia ki ngā rēmana motuhake, ka tuku ki ngā pepa me te tōmato kua tunua.

kasap-sucuk.name: Sūkūku Kaihoko i Paraoahia
kasap-sucuk.description: Hūiheihei tīhi tunua ki te charco, me ngā huawhenua me te riki ki te sumac.

karisik-izgara.name: Kararehe Mixta
karisik-izgara.description: He pereti kī katoa me ngā momo kēmu: balls mīti, kākano heihei, paraka hipi, me te tīhi.

nohut-yemegi.name: Rūrū Pī Kina me te Mīti Hipi
nohut-yemegi.description: He kai ā-ringa o ngā pihikete me te mīti hipi tapahia i tunua āta i roto i te akupara.

patlican-musakka.name: Mōsaka Tūturu
patlican-musakka.description: Wētā pāhi, mīti hipi onepū, me te mōsaka i tunua i te ouhini me te tīhi tōmato, he momo wharekai.

zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.name: Pēpi Pango i te Hinu Ōriva
zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.description: He momo katoa i tunua i te hinu Ōriva me ngā pēpi pango, tōmato, me ngā rikarika, ka tukuna makariri.

tavuk-sote.name: Hēki Heihei I Reri
tavuk-sote.description: Ka rererihia ngā wāhanga heihei i runga i te wera teitei me ngā pepa tae, ngā mātaitai, me ngā tōmato.

izmir-kofte.name: Pihikete Mīti Ōhāmiru-momo
izmir-kofte.description: He rihi tuku iho nui o ngā pōhā mīti kau, tīhi, me ngā pepa i tunua ki te tiihi rēmana.

etli-bezelye.name: Pī me te Mīti Kau
etli-bezelye.description: Hua rīhi ia rā i tunua i roto i te ipu ki te mīti kau tapahia, pī, kāreti, me ngā tīhi.

patlican-oturtma.name: Āwhe Rēmana Tunu me te Mīti Hērere
patlican-oturtma.description: Ka tunua te arero ki te umu me te āwhe, mīti hērere rāwāhi, me te tiihi rēmana me te tīwai.

salgam-suyu.name: Karaka Rutū Huawhenua
salgam-suyu.description: He huawhenua rutū tuku iho, rerekē, kua whakakōhiritia me te kāreti porohita me te huawhenua puehu.

maden-suyu.name: Wai Kohuke
maden-suyu.description: Wai kohuke māori ma, ka tukuna i te makariri.

su.name: Ko te Wai Puna Taiao
su.description: Ko te wai puna taiao e whakaratohia ana kia makariri i roto i một ipu karaihe.

kola.name: Cola
kola.description: He inu waipiro karaehe tuku iho e tukuna ana kia heke te hohonu.

gazoz.name: Soda Ārepa Rēmana
gazoz.description: He inu tawhito katoa, he rongo ātaahua, e tukuna ana kia makariri, kākahu noa.

turk-kahvesi.name: Kōhi Tūkehi
turk-kahvesi.description: Kōhi Tūkehi tuku iho me te āwhi, i tunua i runga i te wera teitei i roto i te cezve kāpia.

demleme-cay.name: Tī Tūkehi Kōhua
demleme-cay.description: Tī Rize hou kua kōhua i te pāmahana wera i roto i tētahi ipu angiangi-waewae.

ev-yapimi-limonata.name: Lēmona Hoki-whakawhanake
ev-yapimi-limonata.description: He rēmana whakahou i whakaritea ia rā me te rēmana hou, menta, me te huka iti.

hosaf.name: Ranu Hua Ia Rā
hosaf.description: He ranu kīhai i te kāinga i kohuatia ia rā me te rīno, āporo maroke, te āporo wera rānei i runga i te wā o te tau.

iskender-kebabi.name: Bursa İskender Kebab
iskender-kebabi.description: Ka kōrerehia te mīti ki runga i te rākau hāngai ki runga i te pide, ka tukuna ki te ranu tōmato, pata wera, me te miraka tīhi.

kazandibi.name: Miraka Pini Karamela
kazandibi.description: He matatiki āhua o te miraka tuku iho i karamela tika, he kowhatu tūturu te whakakoi.

tavuk-gogsu.name: Miraka Pudding Ottoman
tavuk-gogsu.description: He tīhi miraka māmā, ā, he miro, i tunua mā te tohutao tuku iho, ka kawea me te kinamona.

keskul.name: Parāoa Miraka Āmeraka
keskul.description: He tīhi miraka āhua Ōtomania i oti me te kakara āmeraka me te kōhatu niu.

irmik-helvasi.name: Halva Semolina
irmik-helvasi.description: He halva semolina, i pāwhara ki te pata me ngā nati pīn, ka kawea wera, ā, he pūtāwai.

kabak-tatlisi.name: Parakari tīhi me te Tahini
kabak-tatlisi.description: Ko te parakari, i tunua āta i roto i tōna rēmana ake, ka kawea me te tahini me ngā nati.

ayva-tatlisi.name: Parakari Kiwikiwi
ayva-tatlisi.description: Ko te kiwikiwi i tunua me te kawakawa me te kinamona ka kawea me te kirīmi pōkai me ngā nati.

revani.name: Keke Huka Semolina
revani.description: Te parai tuhinga rēhi nāianei e hono ana te keke māmā semolina ki te huka ā-pīhera rēmana.

ekmek-kadayifi.name: Pāhina Parāoa me te Kirīma Pāwera
ekmek-kadayifi.description: Ka whakamāhorahora te pāhina parāoa ki te huka karamele ka kōrerohia me te kirīma pāwera tepo.

cevizli-baklava.name: Baklava Ōriwa
cevizli-baklava.description: Ngā papa ka hurihia kia tino rahi, baklava māmā i hangaia me te nui o ngā ōriwa me te pata noa.
